lines.text: Jesus made His disciples get into the boat and go ahead to Bethsaida, then went up on the mountain to pray.
In the evening the boat was in the middle of the sea, and the disciples strained to row against the wind.
About the fourth watch, Jesus walked toward them on the sea, and they cried out, thinking He was an angel.
Jesus climbed into the boat and the wind died down, and they landed at Capernaum.
People recognized Jesus and carried the sick on mats, and all who touched Him were healed.
